item_short_desc: Rothco’s Spec-4 Polished Insignia set includes 2 brass insignias, perfect for pinning onto uniforms. These insignias come in a sleek black or polished gold finish, allowing for versatile styling. Crafted from durable, lightweight brass, the insignias offer a long-lasting shine while maintaining a professional appearance. Manufactured by a U.S. factory certified by the Institute of Heraldry, this insignia set meets high standards for authenticity and quality.
